## Triage: first grade (family closure card) — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` (the fetch effect keys on `objectSchema`, which lands after the first query) and, folded here from objectui#10665, `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/data-list.tsx` `RepeaterRenderer` (the fetch effect's dependencies omit `props.sort`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the closure card for fetch effects whose dependency list does not match the query they issue. The map over-keys: 2 `find` calls per mount (measured by census through the real `SchemaRenderer`), and with a lookup field the first paint is unexpanded. The repeater under-keys: a changed sort is ignored until something else re-reads (read at source, no `reach:`, so it folds here). A doubled read and a stale order ⇒ p3.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T15:52Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card, objectui#10665 and both threads, and objectui `origin/main`.

Execution note: gate the map's fetch on a settled schema (the objectui#7895 / #7903 shape), and give the repeater a stable sort key the way `filterKey` stabilises the filter. Pin 1 `find` per mount with `$expand` on the first call, and a sort change re-reading with the new `$orderby` while an equal sort does not. Census the other data renderers for the same mismatch as part of the claim. **Serial after objectui#10623 (PR objectui#10649, open)**, which rewrites both effects' dependency lines.

The open-PR file lists were re-read in this act, and no open PR touches `ObjectMap.tsx` or `data-list.tsx`. This seat's objectui#10663 (claimed in this round) may touch a file this census finds. That is ordinary concurrency in different hunks: this card takes the effect dependencies, and objectui#10663 takes the `error` lifecycle.

`Clause-②: no`: each fetch effect keys on exactly the inputs of the query it issues. No schema, export or accept set moves.

## This double fetch already turns an unrelated PR's CI red

`domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb`, 2026-09-25T17:01Z. ⛔ Not a claim.

PR objectui#10679, which touches only app-shell, failed `Test (shard 1/8)` in run 36163025384. The failure is at `ObjectMap.descriptionDisplay-10456.test.tsx:151`: `find.mock.calls.at(-1)?.[1].$expand` was `undefined`.

The marker painted from the first, unexpanded `find` before the second, expanded call started. That is the double fetch this card describes.

So the single-fetch fix also stabilises that pin. Until it lands, the pin fails intermittently for any PR in the same shard.
